name: Last Impression
summary: Ask a dead thing what was done to it. Objects count as dead things.
flavour: It does not speak. It simply stops being ambiguous, and you find you have known for a moment already.

name: Cold on the Air
summary: You feel a room that has recently held a death, or is about to.
flavour: There is a temperature that is not temperature, and you have stopped being able to ignore it.

name: Grave Quiet
summary: Take the stillness the dead keep, and borrow a little of it.
flavour: Nothing that has stopped can panic. You practise stopping.

name: Keep the Vigil
summary: Do the work properly and in company — the acting method, done on purpose.
flavour: You sit up with a stranger's body until dawn because it is what the role asks, and something in you settles that had been rattling.

name: Pallbearer's Hands
summary: What you carry, you can set down anywhere — including on the other side of a door.
flavour: You lift the lid the way you would lift a coffin: steadily, and as though you had been asked to.

name: The Dead Do Not Lie
summary: Speak with the grave's authority, and watch a living man decide not to try it on.
flavour: You say the thing you already know. He hears where you learned it, and stops.

name: Mourner's Coat
summary: Nobody looks twice at grief, or asks it what it is doing here.
flavour: Black gloves, a lowered face, and the whole street politely declines to see you.

name: Count the Cold
summary: Deliberately reach for what the passive sense only murmurs.
flavour: You ask the room how many deaths it is owed, and it answers with a number you did not want.

name: Consecrated Ground
summary: Make the ground under you somewhere the living would rather not follow.
flavour: You walk out unhurried. Behind you, four men discover they have urgent business in the other direction.

name: The Last Word
summary: Ask a question in the voice people answer at a graveside.
flavour: It is not a threat. It is the flat certainty of somebody who has heard the end of a great many stories.

name: Keeper's Rest
summary: Lay your own disquiet down properly, with the rites said over it.
flavour: Everything gets buried eventually. You have simply learned to do your own while you are still using it.

name: Open the Ground
summary: Nothing stays shut against a man whose trade is opening the earth.
flavour: The lock does not break. It concludes, reasonably, that its work is finished.

name: Read the Remains
summary: A full account, from whatever is left of whoever it was.
flavour: You take your time. They have nothing but time, and they are glad of the company.

name: Undertaker's Face
summary: Put on the profession that is welcome everywhere and wanted nowhere.
flavour: Doors open. Nobody meets your eye. Nobody asks your name twice.
